property_summary: After any successful fallback deposit, if block.number is a multiple of 15 the contract's Ether balance must become zero because it transfers all funds; the mutant never transfers, so the balance will be nonzero for some block where block.number % 15 == 0.
change_summary: Remove the `if(block.number % 15 == 0)` conditional and the containing block, so funds are never transferred.
